articles.title: England's mayors to be given power to introduce tourist tax
articles.description: The government is expected to outline how local leaders will be able to impose levies on overnight stays.

articles.title: Iran war will not end until after November US elections, says Trump
articles.description: The president also said oil prices won't come down until after the November races, claiming without evidence that Iran wants to impact the election.

articles.title: Four takeaways from Trump's speech at first Republican midterms convention
articles.description: He covered many of the subjects he has returned to time and again - with a few surprises thrown in.

articles.title: Land in limbo: BBC visits West Bank village in area earmarked by Israel for settlement
articles.description: BBC's Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar in the so-called E1 area, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.
